Fixes #35.

## Summary
- Identifies Wikimedia API requests from formalization and target-label lookup to avoid live 429 failures.
- Rejects grammar-fragment n-grams such as `Hawaii is a`, `a state`, and `is a state` while preserving semantic phrase links.
- Demotes disambiguation-style candidates and renders the U.S.-state predicate as `штат`, producing `Гавайи это штат.`.
- Keeps phrase/CST/Links Notation target metadata consistent when a contextual rule refines source `state` (`Q7275`) into target predicate `штат` (`Q35657`).
- Adds a narrow Rust core semantic fixture for the same issue case, including phrase Q ids, doublet relations, and C ABI helper exports.
- Preserves refreshed issue/PR captures, before/after test logs, CI logs, and case-study research under `docs/case-studies/issue-35/`.

## Reproduction And Evidence
- Before captures are stored in `docs/case-studies/issue-35/data/live-translate-before.md` and `.json`.
- After live CLI capture: `docs/case-studies/issue-35/data/live-translate-after.md` renders `[Гавайи](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%93%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B0%D0%B9%D0%B8 "Q782") это [штат](https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/%D0%A8%D1%82%D0%B0%D1%82_%D0%A1%D0%A8%D0%90 "Q35657").`
- The refreshed JSON capture records `state,Q7275,штат,Q35657` and Links Notation includes `targetId Q35657`.
- Focused failing/passing logs are in `docs/case-studies/issue-35/data/node-issue-35-target-consistency-before.log` and `node-issue-35-target-consistency-after.log`.
- CI investigation logs are in `docs/case-studies/issue-35/ci-logs/`; the old failed run was dependency installation on the placeholder commit, while the latest pre-continuation runs for `a7a0b15` passed.
- Case study: `docs/case-studies/issue-35/README.md`.

## Testing
- `node --test tests/issue-35.test.js`
- `npm test`
- `npm run check`
- `cargo fmt --check`
- `cargo test --workspace`
- `bun test`
- `deno test --allow-read`
- `bash scripts/check-mjs-syntax.sh`
- `bash scripts/check-file-line-limits.sh`
- `npx --yes -p secretlint -p @secretlint/secretlint-rule-preset-recommend secretlint "**/*"`
- `GITHUB_BASE_REF=main node scripts/validate-changeset.mjs`
- `node scripts/check-version.mjs`
- `git diff --check`
title: fix: stabilize Hawaii translation quality

Fixes #37.

## Summary
- Compacts overlong Translate page issue-report URLs only after measuring the encoded URL, preserving source text, source formalization Markdown, formalized target Markdown, options/status, questions, reproduction steps, and a report note.
- Exposes the latest Translate result to page reporting so the report captures exact Markdown payloads instead of only rendered DOM text.
- Prefers the supported Wiktionary compound `is-a` for `is a`, while keeping generic multi-token stop-word spans skipped.
- Links the Russian `это` rule token in English-to-Russian translations and keeps existing Hawaii translation expectations updated.
- Adds the issue-37 case study, captured source data, online research notes, requirements, and a patch changeset.

## Verification
- `npm test`
- `npm run check`
- `npm run changeset:status`
title: fix: compact Translate issue reports and grammar links

## What

- Adds a `/translate` library, CLI, HTTP, and web surface that formalizes source text first, then translates sentence renderings through Wikidata Q/P labels and explicit transformation rules.
- Preserves formalized source Markdown/HTML from the CST with source character ranges, so sentence punctuation round-trips before translation.
- Records translation steps for API requests/responses/cache hits, formalization, phrase translation, transformation rules, sentence assembly, and final text output.
- Keeps unresolved source parts as variables with questions unless a deterministic rule resolves them; the default example is now `Hawaii is a state.` -> `Гавайи - штат.`.
- Updates issue #16 requirements, case-study data, solution plan, online research notes, changeset, and the committed web screenshot.

Fixes #16.

## Screenshot

![Translate page](https://github.com/link-assistant/meta-expression/blob/issue-16-a4cb3c8415b5/docs/case-studies/issue-16/translate-page.png?raw=true)

## Reproduction

- Before this PR, `/formalize` did not expose enough CST detail to regenerate source punctuation, and `/translate` only handled phrase replacement instead of sentence/text rendering.
- `tests/issue-16.test.js` now reproduces the issue with `Hawaii is a state.`, asserting formalized input preservation, sentence output, English article/copula transformation rules, trace steps, Links Notation step lines, unresolved-variable behavior, CLI output, HTTP `/translate`, and static web wiring.

## Testing

- `npm test`
- `npm run check`

- `deno test --allow-read`
- `scripts/check-file-line-limits.sh`

body:
## Summary

Fixes #29.

Adds page-aware GitHub issue reporting across the static web app. The top navigation now exposes a global Report Issue link, and the existing Analyse report link uses the same shared reporter.

## What Changed

- Added `web/page-report.js` to generate GitHub `/issues/new` URLs with active page state for Analyse, Compare, Formalize, Translate, and Preferences.
- Added `web/app-version.js` plus Pages workflow metadata generation at `_site/web/app-version.json` so deployed reports include package version, commit SHA, ref, build time, and source.
- Added a case study under `docs/case-studies/issue-29` with issue data, calculator reference data, requirements, research, and solution plan.
- Added `.changeset/issue-29-page-reporting.md` for the next release.

## Reproduction

Before this change, only Analyse had a report link, and other pages could not open a prefilled issue with their current state. To verify the fix, open the web app, switch to any page, and activate Report Issue. The generated GitHub issue URL includes the active page, page-specific content, environment details, and app version metadata.

## Verification

- `node --test tests/issue-29.test.js`
- `npm test`
- `npm run check`
- `bash scripts/check-file-line-limits.sh`
- `git diff --check`
- `bun test`
- `deno test --allow-read`
- Playwright smoke test over Analyse, Compare, Formalize, Translate, and Preferences confirmed each global report link captures the active page and the local version label renders as `v0.9.0`.

## Screenshot

![Global report issue link and version badge](https://github.com/link-assistant/meta-expression/blob/issue-29-e5195b346fed/docs/screenshots/issue-29/page-reporting.png?raw=true)
title: Add page-aware GitHub issue reporting

body:
Fixes #23.

## Summary

Single-PR overhaul of the static `web/` prototype that addresses all seven
items from the issue:

- **R1** — readable contrast inside the `<details>` panels
- **R2** — clean radio fieldsets (Link Target / Sources / Interpretation Display)
- **R3** — switchable interpretation display modes (`id` / `name` / `name+meaning` / `meaning` / `replace`)
- **R4** — clickable interpretations; the active choice is always present in the top‑10
- **R5** — language switching (`en`, `ru`) with `navigator.language` detection + `localStorage` override
- **R6** — theme switching (`auto`, `light`, `dark`) with `prefers-color-scheme` detection + `localStorage` override
- **R7** — mobile-first responsive layout (single column ≤640px, two-column from 640px, full app-shell from 960px)

## Case study

Full design rationale, root-cause analysis, and library survey lives in
[`docs/case-studies/issue-23/README.md`](https://github.com/link-assistant/meta-expression/blob/issue-23-0aed78e996ae/docs/case-studies/issue-23/README.md).

## Visual evidence (after)

| What | Light | Dark |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Formalize panels open (R1, R4) | ![light](https://github.com/link-assistant/meta-expression/blob/issue-23-0aed78e996ae/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/03-formalize-payload-light.png?raw=true) | ![dark](https://github.com/link-assistant/meta-expression/blob/issue-23-0aed78e996ae/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/04-formalize-payload-dark.png?raw=true) |
| Formalize options (R2, R3) | ![options](https://github.com/link-assistant/meta-expression/blob/issue-23-0aed78e996ae/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/02-formalize-light.png?raw=true) | — |
| Russian locale (R5, R6) | — | ![ru-dark](https://github.com/link-assistant/meta-expression/blob/issue-23-0aed78e996ae/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/05-formalize-russian-dark.png?raw=true) |
| `name+meaning` mode (R3) | ![name+meaning](https://github.com/link-assistant/meta-expression/blob/issue-23-0aed78e996ae/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/07-formalize-name-meaning.png?raw=true) | — |
| Mobile 390×844 (R7) | ![mobile](https://github.com/link-assistant/meta-expression/blob/issue-23-0aed78e996ae/docs/case-studies/issue-23/screenshots/06-analyse-mobile-light.png?raw=true) | — |

## How to reproduce locally

```sh
npm install
npm test          # 110 tests, 27 suites, all green
npm run check     # eslint + prettier + jscpd + docs:formalize:check

# UI:
python3 -m http.server 4567   # from repo root
# open http://localhost:4567/web/index.html
```

| --- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| R1  | `.formalize-payload pre` routed through `var(--surface)` / `var(--ink)`; dark theme overrides exist | screenshots 03 + 04                             |
| R2  | Combined `.formalize-target, .formalize-sources, .formalize-display-mode` use `display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap`, options use `display: inline-flex` | screenshot 02                                   |
| R3  | `formatInterpretationPhrase` covers id / name / name+meaning / meaning / replace + fallback | screenshot 07                                   |
| R4  | `interpretationKey` produces stable, comparable keys with `∅` for empty slots | screenshot 03 (`#1` marked **ACTIVE**)          |
| R5  | `detectLocale('ru-RU' / 'en-US' / 'de-DE' / '')`, `translate`, `listLocales`  | screenshot 05                                   |
| R6  | `THEMES` cycles `auto → light → dark`, `effectiveTheme`, `themeIcon`           | screenshot 04                                   |
| R7  | `.app-shell { grid-template-columns: 1fr }` default, `min-width:640px` + `960px` breakpoints, no legacy `max-width:820px` | screenshot 06                                   |
| Wiring | `index.html` contains `id="locale-select"`, `id="theme-toggle"`, `color-scheme`, every `data-i18n` slot, all 5 display radios | screenshots 01–07                               |
